Intro: This fixture is used for deterministic chunking regression tests.
It has several paragraphs with predictable boundaries and stable punctuation.

Paragraph 1: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Numbers: 12345.
This line exists to give the splitter multiple separator choices.

Paragraph 2: Chunking should prefer paragraph boundaries when possible.
We keep sentence length moderate so the recursive splitter behaves consistently.

Paragraph 3: A second section begins here. It contains commas, periods, and a colon:
to avoid accidental edge cases with empty separators.

Paragraph 4: The goal is not semantic meaning; it is regression stability.
We want the same chunk hashes across runs for the same input text.

Paragraph 5: Short lines and long lines are mixed. Some lines are intentionally longer
to force splits near the chunk_size threshold without relying on random behavior.

Paragraph 6: End of fixture. The final paragraph should still be included.
